title: Text pipeline: stage align/multiline rendering, real font handling in SWF
description: Stage side (packages/core/src/engine/renderer.ts:276-316): ctx.textAlign is set from obj.align but text always draws at obj.x (box left edge), so center/right text hangs outside the left of its box — draw at x+width/2 / x+width; wrapText splits only on spaces so explicit newlines are ignored and multiline/wordWrap flags are unused. SWF side (packages/swf/src/text.ts:117-118): DefineEditText sets HasFont with FontID=0, a dangling reference to a never-defined character — for MVP use device fonts (UseOutlines=0, font name) or emit a minimal DefineFont2; fontFamily/bold/italic are currently ignored. EditText flag-bit encoding bugs themselves are 0047 scope. See docs/06-text-typography.md.
